GET probe returned 200 (list of entries), not 405. A 200 GET response does not confirm or deny PUT support on this path — it only confirms GET is valid. PUT existence on this path cannot be determined from this probe alone.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
get:
  summary: List a user's time entries
  description: |
    Returns a paginated list of time entries for the specified user
    in the workspace. Used by clockify_entries_list.
  operationId: getUserTimeEntries
  parameters:
    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: page, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}
    - {name: page-size, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Array of time entry objects
post:
  summary: Start a timer for a user
  operationId: startUserTimer
  parameters:
    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
  responses:
    '201':
      description: Created time entry
patch:
  summary: Stop or update the running timer for a user
  operationId: stopUserTimer
  parameters:
    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Stopped time entry

endpoints.notes: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE. GET probe returned 200 confirming the path is a valid list endpoint. The path /user/{userId}/time-entries is used by typed tools for GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE only. clockify_entries_update (the entry update tool) uses PUT /workspaces/{wId}/time-entries/{timeEntryId} — not this path. The PUT raw allowlist entry for this path is unused by any typed tool and its live behavior is not confirmed. No discrepancy with the typed implementation: the correct typed update path is the single-entry path.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  summary: Update a workspace user
  description: |
    Updates user properties within the workspace, including status.
    Used by clockify_users_deactivate to set status=INACTIVE.
    No typed tool for general user property updates exists; raw fallback
    via CLOCKIFY_ENABLE_RAW_WRITES=true is the only path for other updates.
  operationId: updateWorkspaceUser
  parameters:
    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            status:
              type: string
              enum:
                - ACTIVE
                - INACTIVE
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Updated user object
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED. GET probe returns 405 confirming path registration and PUT as the supported method. clockify_users_deactivate is the typed tool covering this path — it issues PUT with status=INACTIVE. No discrepancies. Source and spec agree. The full-update (non-deactivate) capability of this path is accessible only via raw fallback.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  summary: Set a workspace user cost rate
  description: |
    Updates the default cost rate for a user at the workspace level.
    This rate applies when no project-level or task-level cost rate overrides it.
    No typed MCP tool covers this endpoint; use raw fallback with
    CLOCKIFY_ENABLE_RAW_WRITES=true if needed.
  operationId: updateWorkspaceUserCostRate
  parameters:
    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            amount:
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
            since:
              type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: User object with updated cost rate
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED (path existence). GET probe returns 405 confirming path registration and PUT as the supported method. Consistent with workspace/{wId}/projects/{projectId}/users/{userId}/cost-rate pattern confirmed live in iter21. Gap: no typed MCP tool for workspace-level user cost-rate. The project-scoped variant has clockify_projects_rates_update (project_admin.go:179) but the workspace-level equivalent is raw-fallback only. No spec discrepancy — the path exists as documented.
